name: PaintBall 255
summary: Paintball 255 is a culturally immersive Afro-environment paintball game that reimagines traditional gaming landscapes by centering African aesthetics, music, and narratives. Set along the warm, sandy beaches of the East African coast, drawing inspiration from Zanzibar and the broader Swahili coastline, the game offers a visually rich, sunlit environment infused with African textures, sounds, and artifacts.
